invariants: Peter Jackson film screenplay chronology and outcomes remain immutable.
Optional play exists only inside film-safe gaps and never changes required outcomes.
Raw owner reference PDFs/images are reference-only and are not shipping dependencies.
Project-owned assets may be used immediately; external assets require item-level license evidence in ExternalAssetManifest.
No implementation or visual claim is promoted beyond actual evidence.
Part II and Part III remain source-verification gated.

story_source_hierarchy.rule: Screenplays own film chronology and required outcomes; production bibles translate that source into game/world/mission/visual constraints and may not rewrite it.
story_source_hierarchy.resource_helper_rule: Bible 09 may guide discovery/prototyping of voices, music, SFX, character references, 3D assets, animation/mocap and AI-assisted asset creation. It may not supply canon facts or override the supplied screenplays or production bibles 01-08.

rules: Record source URL, creator/uploader, filename, date and intended use for every external candidate.
Never bypass DRM, paywalls, passwords, access controls or technical protections.
Treat uncertain/franchise-specific material as personal/local reference or temporary prototype unless separately cleared.
Any future distributed build requires release-clearance review for third-party items.
Normalize scale, pivots, topology, UVs, collision, LODs, skeleton/retargeting, material count and audio properties before integration.
